construction.confirmation: ConfirmationModal using WorkspaceDialogFrame without a second draft blocker
construction.appearance: Existing semantic surface, text, border and state tokens; responsive single-column cards with two-column fields on larger screens
construction.asset_selection: Explicit checkboxes; 100-row summary pages; filter applies only to the disclosed loaded set; maximum 250 targets

safety_contract: Every workspace and execution confirmation identifies simulation; recorded progress comes from server attempts.
Monitoring module write policy and the server-authenticated tenant role gate planning. Actor-bound operations also match the authenticated actor from capabilities.
The API remains authoritative for actor, tenant, target revisions, preview expiry, risk facts and lifecycle transitions.
An uncertain create retries the exact same serialized request and idempotency key. Form edits are disabled until the outcome is recovered.
A failed lifecycle request requires a fresh server read before another write; no automatic write retry occurs.
Rollback retains its attempt identity after an uncertain request; canceling confirmation never captures a stale rollback reason.
Draft departure can be canceled without reopening the same blocked navigation. Explicit discard permits leaving; late save completion cannot reopen the departed action.
Write-permission loss makes the retained plan read only. Credentials must not be entered into context, references or notes.
Existing maintenance-window records and APIs remain; the UI lists windows and can link an existing window on a selected target. No schema migration or data deletion is introduced.
